echoParts: Look at the birds of the air
They do not sow or reap
and yet your heavenly Father feeds them
verseText: Look at the birds of the air: They do not sow or reap or gather into barns, and yet your heavenly Father feeds them. Are you not much more valuable than they?
meaning: Birds aren’t farmers. They must rely on God to take care of their needs. We can trust our heavenly Father to care for us because we are even more valuable to him.

recall.question: Who does Jesus say feeds the birds of the air?

meaning.question: Why does Jesus tell us to look at how God cares for the birds?
choices: We are more valuable to God than birds
We should be thankful we don't have to eat worms
Birds are interesting to look at

application.prompt: Have you ever see a bird plant seeds like a farmer? Of course not! They have to trust God to feed them each day. When you feel worried about something you need, remember that God feeds the birds, so he'll definitely take care of you, too! What is one worry you can bring to God and trust Him with today?
